azimuthAssessment.azimuthRecommendationText: The result suggests a small adjustment may improve electrical balance, but stop if high-frequency response or distortion symmetry worsens.

distortionSymmetry.interpretation: The right channel shows higher third-harmonic distortion. This may indicate asymmetric groove-wall tracing, azimuth error, anti-skate imbalance, stylus wear, cartridge asymmetry, or test-record wear.

azimuthAssessment.electricalInterpretation: Electrical crosstalk is reasonably balanced at 1 kHz. Confirm with sweep response and distortion symmetry before making mechanical conclusions.
azimuthAssessment.integratedGuidanceText: The 1 kHz test is not fully balanced: right-to-left leakage is higher. A small azimuth adjustment may help, but the sweep was not measured, so there is no broadband check. THD symmetry is not ideal, so any azimuth change should be very small and re-tested.
measurementWarnings: Sweep validation was not available; this is primarily a 1 kHz electrical crosstalk reference.

distortionSymmetry.interpretation: The right channel shows higher third-harmonic distortion. This may indicate asymmetric groove-wall tracing, azimuth error, anti-skate imbalance, stylus wear, cartridge asymmetry, or test-record wear.
